امتزجا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَزَجَا (imtazajā) /im.ta.za.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# اُمْتُزِجَا (umtuzijā) /um.tu.zi.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# اِمْتَزِجَا (imtazijā) /im.ta.zi.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
